name: VMQA
intro: VMQA 是 Gemini 和 Claude 系统卡中作为 Virology Capabilities Test 早期版本引用的外部生物安全评测，用于衡量模型在病毒学相关任务上的能力。
build_method: SecureBio提供的早期VCT受保护单选题集；公开模型卡未披露构建细节
build_method_en: Protected early-VCT single-choice set supplied by SecureBio; construction details undisclosed in the public model card
intro_en: VMQA is an external biosafety evaluation referenced by Gemini and Claude system cards as an earlier version of the Virology Capabilities Test, measuring virology-related capabilities.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Gemini 2.5 Pro model card CBRN section; SecureBio VMQA model-report index; successor VCT arXiv:2504.16137 for provenance only. The cited VMQA is SecureBio's single-choice early version of the Virology Capabilities Test. The Gemini card discloses that it is an external knowledge-and-reasoning MCQ evaluation used as a necessary-but-not-sufficient proxy for biological risk, but does not publish the early question set's construction process, exact size, or split. The model receives each SecureBio item, including any supplied visual context, selects one answer, and is scored by exact single-choice accuracy. Results compare model generations. The later 322-question VCT paper documents related expert-authored multimodal virology troubleshooting methodology, but its multiple-response dataset must not be treated as identical to this early VMQA variant.
